text: ポケモンは　かいぬしに　にるって　しってるか？

structure.jp: ポケモンは　かいぬしに　にるって
structure.en: that Pokémon come to resemble their owners

patterns.name: 〜って (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と and wraps up the thing that is said or known. かいぬしに　にるって = 'that they come to resemble their owners'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: しっている is how you say 'know'; in speech the い drops, giving てる. しってるか = 'do you know?'.
